## GrowAssistant – Crop Steering v0.1.12

This release updates drain-sensor semantics for P2 and adds optional P3 Emergency Dryback Shots to protect plants during the dryback phase.

### P2 drain-sensor semantics

- The normal Drain Sensor no longer blocks P2 irrigation.
- A wet or unavailable normal Drain Sensor is diagnostic-only during P2.
- The Drain Tray remains a fail-closed safety gate and still blocks irrigation when wet or unavailable.
- Existing P1 Drain Sensor behavior remains unchanged.

### P3 Emergency Dryback Shots

P3 Emergency provides optional irrigation protection while the integration remains in phase `p3_dryback`.

It is configurable with:

- Enable/disable
- VWC threshold
- Emergency shot duration
- Soak/wait time
- Maximum emergency shots per light cycle
- Emergency Shots Done counter

P3 Emergency becomes ready only when all of the following are true:

- Phase is `p3_dryback`.
- The emergency feature is enabled.
- VWC is valid and at or below the configured threshold.
- The soak period has finished.
- The shot limit has not been reached.
- The shot duration is valid and greater than zero.
- The pump is off.
- The Drain Tray is explicitly configured, available, and dry.

The normal Drain Sensor does not block P3 Emergency. The Drain Tray remains fail-closed.

P3 Emergency Shots Done resets once at the start of each new light cycle together with the existing cycle reset. Last Shot is preserved by the cycle reset.

### Optional Shot Engine Blueprint

- Added the new P3 Emergency branch and its inputs.
- Pump control remains in the optional Home Assistant Blueprint; no native Python pump-on control was introduced.
- Existing P1/P2 pump behavior remains unchanged.
- Existing Blueprint automations created with an older Blueprint version need the new P3 inputs assigned after updating the Blueprint.

### Live validation

The feature was manually validated in Home Assistant:

- P3 Emergency readiness became true below the configured test threshold.
- The Blueprint executed one real 30-second emergency pump shot.
- P3 Emergency Shots Done incremented from 0 to 1.
- Last Shot was updated.
- The soak countdown started after the shot.
- After soak expired and Max Shots was set to 1, readiness stayed false with status `p3_emergency_shot_limit_reached`.
